item.title: Boosie Badazz: Why Nobody Can Out Hustle Me
item.dc:creator: Nia Noelle
item.description: Boosie Badazz discusses his sold-out tour success, new streaming platform, alternative ticketing service, relentless work ethic, and unwavering Sunday church commitment.
item.content:encoded:
Boosie Badazz walked into the studio like he never left. The show’s executive producer and unofficial third co-host joined Incognito and DJ Misses on “Posted On the Corner” with plenty to discuss and a few surprises.

Owning the Cash Money/No Limit Tour

Boosie called his run on the Cash Money/No Limit tour “legendary,” with sold-out crowds every night. In Birmingham, promoter Blake gave him 10 extra minutes on stage, and he admitted he went over that too. He has also circled November 15 in Cleveland, a show that falls around his birthday.

Music You Can’t Categorize

When asked about fans who break down in tears when they meet him, Boosie said the moment humbles him. He believes his music connects because it covers every part of life.

“I can make you dance, cry, jump, fight,” he said. “You can’t put me in a category.”

Boosie Network and Boosie Events

Boosie Network now offers eight to nine new films, fishing vlogs and the Boosie Mall. The Mall sells merch and items straight from his closet. Subscriptions cost $4.99 a month, and the first month is free.

He also pitched boosievents.com as an alternative to Ticketmaster for event promoters. He said Ticketmaster takes 7%, while he charges 2.5% and never touches the promoter’s money.

TRENDING STORY: 8 Boosie Songs We Want to Hear on the Cash Money & No Limit Tour

TRENDING STORY: Boosie Badazz Sues Far-Right Lobbyists Over Failed Trump Pardon

Scraping the Pot

Boosie described a steady work ethic built on after-parties, features, clothing drops and restaurant appearances. His goal is to double his back-end earnings every weekend, and he says he did it nine weekends in a row. He has been booked 31 weekends straight. He explained that being on paper limits his travel unless he is working.

He now plans to ask a judge for permission to travel to Thailand for stem cell treatment for his diabetes. He also hopes to spend some time on the beach while he is there.

Faith on Sundays

Incognito and DJ Misses noted that Boosie never misses church. He finds a Baptist church in whatever city he is in, checks the reviews, and slides into the back row. Raised by a preacher grandfather, he said giving back to God remains a priority.

Next up is “Bonfire Boosie,” a cold-weather concert on his land. He plans soul singers, rap acts, sleeping bags and a roaring fire.

item.title: Kanye West Brings Yeezy Back With Runway Show & New Retail Plans
item.dc:creator: Weso
item.description: Kanye West is reportedly bringing the Yeezy brand back with new products on the way and an upcoming runway show. For the first time four years, Yeezy fans could see new products hit the shelves at the brand’s flagship store in Los Angeles. Following a soft launch earlier this year, Ye appears ready to give […]
item.content:encoded:
Kanye West is reportedly bringing the Yeezy brand back with new products on the way and an upcoming runway show.

For the first time four years, Yeezy fans could see new products hit the shelves at the brand’s flagship store in Los Angeles. Following a soft launch earlier this year, Ye appears ready to give the brand a fresh start.

According to Women’s Wear Daily, Kanye has partnered with JD Sports to stock Yeezy slides. He’s also reportedly planning to release the Yeezy 800 sneaker, giving fans more footwear to look forward to.

Outside of the Yeezy comeback, Ye has also inked a new distribution deal with Gamma, marking another move as he looks to push his latest music.

During Gamma’s meeting with Urban One, CEO Larry Jackson FaceTimed Ye, who spoke about his upcoming album, BULLY, and explained why its success means more to him than some of his biggest career milestones.

“I just wanted to thank y’all so much for getting behind this on this journey. These number ones mean even more than the Graduation’s and the Watch the Throne’s, and all the number ones before because, as you know, about a year into the project, I went into an episode.”

Meanwhile, Hit-Boy, one of the producers who contributed to Watch The Throne, previously shared his thoughts on the album’s lasting impact and why he believes its combination of production and lyricism remains difficult to top.

“That sh*t meant everything, it’s just such a high level of production wise and rap wise. It’s hard to top some sh*t like that. I know n*ggas be breaking streaming records with every song they drop but I still don’t think too much has dropped that could f*ck with Watch The Throne.”

item.title: ‘Modern Warfare 4’ Exclusive: Mads Mikkelsen & Barry Sloane Tease The Archer & Price Crossing Paths
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launches October 23 with new villain The Archer (Mads Mikkelsen) and returning Captain Price (Barry Sloane) in a campaign set against North-South Korea tensions.
item.content:encoded:
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 officially releases on October 23, but some gamers eager to get boots on the ground are already playing the new campaign thanks to early access. This latest chapter in Modern Warfare features a new villain, The Archer (Mads Mikkelsen), and mainstay John Price (Barry Sloane). We spoke with the actors who bring them to life in the popular first-person shooter.

Modern Warfare 4 feels ripped from real-life headlines and set against the backdrop of longstanding tensions between South Korea and North Korea.

The game puts you in the boots of a young South Korean marine embedded in a squad of soldiers that is fighting for survival in the midst of a North Korean invasion that also has global implications.

You also play as everyone’s favorite protagonist, Captain Price, who has gone dark and is on the run after assassinating General Shepherd in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, which also led to the disbanding of Task Force 141, putting former allies on opposite sides.

Mads Mikkelsen Reveals The Archer Has Been Working In The Shadows

Modern Warfare also introduces The Archer, played by Mikkelsen, Russia’s Defense Minister, with other titles and global ambitions we won’t spoil. Still, he doesn’t stray far from the Modern Warfare villain tree and threatens global stability.

Speaking with Mikkelsen, he broke down what we can expect from The Archer without giving too much away about the mysterious villain, but he did reveal that, while he is new to the Modern Warfare family, The Archer has been working in the shadows for a long time.

“Well, I’m new to the family, but the Archer is not. Archer has somehow been there since the start, and that will be quite clear once you start playing the game,” Mikkelsen begins. “Something we have waited for, somebody we’ve waited for. He’s got friends in this world, and he’s got enemies, and it’s a blurry world: which one is what? But that’s all I can say. But he has a very big ambition, let’s put it that way.”

Barry Sloane Says Price Is More On The Human Side Than The Darker Side

As for Price, he finds himself in a pickle due to his actions in the previous game. We asked Barry Sloane about returning as the character who is now in a much “darker tone,” now that he is on the run and being pursued by his former teammates Ghost and Gaz; he explained what we are experiencing with Price in this game.

“Well, if you shoot a member of the American military in the face in the Pentagon, it’s definitely a strongly worded letter from HR, probably a dismissal,” Sloane jokingly begins. “And so he’s found himself bunkering down in New York and finding new ways that he can quite possibly be useful. I think what we’re seeing from him isn’t necessarily a darker side, but a more human side.”

He continued, “We’re seeing the process of the weight that he’s carrying more clearly than we’ve seen in previous games. And I think that’s going to make us be actually drawn closer to him than further away, even though some of his actions may appear more questionable morally than in previous games. But I think by the end of the game, when you’ve been on the sticks, you’ll be able to make a decision on how you feel those decisions played out.”

What We Can Expect When The Archer & Price Cross Paths

As for what fans can expect when Price and The Archer cross paths in the game, Mikkelsen teased something to look forward to, while Infinity Ward’s narrative director added that the Casino Royale star shook things up by joining the game’s cast, and that we will not be disappointed.

“We’re going to be excited to see these two together. I think you spoke earlier, didn’t you, about heroes and villains, which is which two sides of one coin, basically elements of each other in each other,” Mikkelsen said. “And so they’ll listen to each other’s viewpoints, and both believe they’re right, I assume. And then there’s an interesting dynamic here. I definitely need him, but I also need a piece of him.”

Negus adds, “I want to share one other thing with you. It’s obviously not an accident that these two guys are in these two roles and the energy that each of these guys brought to it, the new energy from Mace being able to come in and shake things up, very collaborative, very playful, the way that these two work together, it will not disappoint when people get to play the game.”

Consider us very hyped. We are currently making our way through the campaign and will share our thoughts, so keep it locked on HHW Gaming.

item.title: Diddy Back In Gen Pop After Prison Transfer
item.dc:creator: Stephen A. Crockett Jr.
item.description: Sean “Diddy” Combs has returned to general population following his transfer to a new prison, marking a change in his living conditions after reportedly facing disciplinary action at his previous facility. Jose Rojas, a union secretary representing Bureau of Prisons employees, told TMZ that Combs is now housed in general population at FCI Allenwood in […]
item.content:encoded:
Sean “Diddy” Combs has returned to general population following his transfer to a new prison, marking a change in his living conditions after reportedly facing disciplinary action at his previous facility.

Jose Rojas, a union secretary representing Bureau of Prisons employees, told TMZ that Combs is now housed in general population at FCI Allenwood in Pennsylvania. The music mogul was transferred there last week from Fort Dix in New Jersey, where he had spent nearly a year behind bars, TMZ reports.

Allenwood houses approximately 1,000 inmates, compared with roughly 4,000 at Fort Dix. The smaller population could make it easier for prison staff to monitor Combs, though officials have not publicly explained the circumstances surrounding his new housing assignment.

Combs’ representative, Juda Engelmayer, welcomed the news while emphasizing his client’s safety.

“If this information is accurate, we’re pleased to hear that Sean has returned to general population,” Engelmayer told TMZ. “His safety and well-being are always important to us, but we have no specific reason to believe he is at risk.”

Combs is serving a 50-month sentence after being convicted in 2025 on two prostitution-related charges. He was acquitted of the more serious charges of sex trafficking and racketeering.

His time at Fort Dix reportedly included multiple disciplinary infractions involving alleged fighting and the use of unauthorized cellphones. NBC News also reported that his life behind bars allegedly included access to alcohol, massages, elaborate meals and a contraband cellphone containing nude photographs.

The reported violations eventually landed Combs in the prison’s Special Housing Unit, commonly known as the SHU, which is used to separate certain inmates from the general population.

According to TMZ’s sources, Combs also lost 41 days of good-time credit, which can reduce an inmate’s sentence, as well as 400 days of commissary privileges.

The Bureau of Prisons declined to discuss Combs’ individual circumstances, citing security and privacy concerns.

“For privacy, safety, and security reasons, we do not comment on the conditions of confinement for any individual in our custody, including housing assignments,” a BOP representative told TMZ.

It remains unclear whether Combs will face additional restrictions at Allenwood or how his reported disciplinary history might affect the remainder of his sentence.

item.title: Pooh Shiesty Seeks Better Jail Conditions As Prosecutors Allege Fentanyl Use
item.dc:creator: Weso
item.description: Pooh Shiesty is pushing for better jail conditions, claiming he’s unhappy with his current living situation. The Memphis rapper has reportedly complained about spending 23 hours a day alone in his cell, with only two hours of visits from family and friends each month. Prosecutors, however, are telling a different story. They claim the Back […]
item.content:encoded:
Pooh Shiesty is pushing for better jail conditions, claiming he’s unhappy with his current living situation.

The Memphis rapper has reportedly complained about spending 23 hours a day alone in his cell, with only two hours of visits from family and friends each month.

Prosecutors, however, are telling a different story. They claim the Back In Blood rapper has access to a tablet that allows him to make video calls and play video games to pass the time. Based on those claims, they are asking the judge to deny his request for improved living conditions.

Prosecutors have also raised safety concerns about Shiesty’s time at a halfway house, alleging that he tampered with monitoring equipment and caused disruptions. They also claims that two fans broke into the halfway house to get his autograph.

Additionally, prosecutors reminded the judge that Shiesty allegedly admitted to taking fentanyl during a court hearing. These allegations could complicate his efforts to secure better conditions as his legal situation continues to unfold.

However, Pooh Shiesty’s attorney has pushed back against the prosecutors’ claims, arguing that his client’s current circumstances are far more restrictive than they suggest.

“He is locked down 23 hours per day and has no contact with anyone other than staff,” Schaffer told Complex. “If by some stretch of the imagination it’s true, then they need to take a close look at their staff and their ability to run a jail.”

item.title: The Bubble Is Bursting: EA Shuts Down BioWare, XBOX Will Reportedly Undergo Another Round of Layoffs
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: BioWare shuts down after EA layoffs; Mass Effect 5 cancelled. Xbox faces more job cuts and console price concerns amid industry turmoil.
item.content:encoded:
On top of gaming becoming a ridiculously expensive hobby, we learned that legendary game studio BioWare won’t be making any new games after being shut down, and XBOX is reportedly preparing to lay off more employees.

Pour one out for BioWare, the iconic studio behind the Dragon Age and Mass Effect franchise, and for bangers like Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic, Jade Empire, Neverwinter Nights, and Baldur’s Gate. Bloomberg reported that EA is shuttering the studio as part of mass layoffs at the video game company, which will cut 400 employees, including 50 at BioWare.

After Dragon Age: Inquisition brought the franchise’s best sales, BioWare released the disaster that was Anthem, then Dragon Age: The Veilguard, which also had troubled development and underperformed.

BioWare found mixed success with the Mass Effect franchise, with the first three games earning its place in the hearts of gamers forever. At the same time, Mass Effect Andromeda was a massive disappointment with fans. Still, BioWare recovered some of the good standing it lost with the Mass Effect faithful with the release of the Legendary Edition remaster.

Mass Effect 5 Is Dead

BioWare spent its last few years teasing the next chapter in the Mass Effect universe, dropping tiny details and revealing it would take place 100 years after the events of Mass Effect 3, after your version of Commander Shepard stopped the Reaper invasion.

Now fans sadly won’t know what to expect from Mass Effect 5, after BioWare confirmed in a social media statement that development has stopped.

As expected, you can hear the collective cries of gamers with a personal connection to BioWare’s games across social media.

RIP BioWare. Mass Effect will always hold a special place in our hearts here at HHW Gaming.

More Layoffs Are Reportedly Coming at Xbox

Fresh off news that their next console could cost about $1,800, Fortune reports that as part of Xbox’s ongoing reset under Asha Sharma’s leadership, more layoffs can be expected in October, November, and January.

The report also touches on the possibility of selling XBOX.

Per Polygon:

In the report, Jason Althoff, CEO of Microsoft’s commercial business, downplayed the lingering rumor that Xbox may be spun off and sold.

“Asha is one of the best leaders we have at the whole company,” Althoff said. “We would not have put her on a business we intend to sell. There’s going to be a ton of speculation about all this. Time will tell.” Sharma previously said that the Xbox division is not for sale in a statement to The New York Times.

News of more possible layoffs isn’t sitting well with gamers on social media, who feel for the affected employees and constantly worry they could lose their jobs at any moment.

The video game industry is clearly in turmoil.

item.title: Big30 Denies Gucci Mane Robbery, Calls Out Internet Detectives
item.dc:creator: Weso
item.description: Big30 is finally speaking out about the alleged robbery involving Gucci Mane. The Memphis rapper has been accused of being involved alongside Pooh Shiesty and his father in the alleged kidnapping and robbery of Gucci Mane. Since then, Pooh Shiesty has remained behind bars without bond, while Big30 is out awaiting trial. In the meantime, […]
item.content:encoded:
Big30 is finally speaking out about the alleged robbery involving Gucci Mane.

The Memphis rapper has been accused of being involved alongside Pooh Shiesty and his father in the alleged kidnapping and robbery of Gucci Mane. Since then, Pooh Shiesty has remained behind bars without bond, while Big30 is out awaiting trial.

In the meantime, Big30 has briefly addressed the situation on social media, denying rumors that anyone cooperated with police. Speculation began swirling online about whether he had snitched because he wasn’t locked up alongside the other defendants. 

Now, Big30 is addressing the allegations head-on. He recently sat down with Big Bank for an exclusive interview, where he denied that the robbery happened the way authorities alleged, despite what surveillance footage appears to show.

“We innocent. What they said we did, we didn’t do. Give a f*ck how they look at it. Nah, what they said we did in that paperwork, we didn’t do. It didn’t happen. I ain’t do that. Like, you can’t make me say that. You’re going to have to prove to me I did that. Give a f*ck what they said or what you saw. I feel good about my situation.”

Big30 also addressed the social media sleuths who have been dissecting the case, criticizing those who been sharing their own theories about what happened.

“Yeah, n***as be trying to be internet lawyers and police. At least say, ‘I hope it go well for them’ or something like that, instead of bringing a Black man down.”

item.title: Funkmaster Flex Gets Into Heated Brawl During Knicks-Sixers Game
item.dc:creator: Stephen A. Crockett Jr.
item.description: Funkmaster Flex brought some unexpected heat to Madison Square Garden on Tuesday night, and this time it had nothing to do with the Knicks-Sixers matchup. The legendary Hot 97 DJ found himself in a physical altercation with another man inside the packed Manhattan arena, with video capturing the confrontation as it spiraled into a full-blown […]
item.content:encoded:
Funkmaster Flex brought some unexpected heat to Madison Square Garden on Tuesday night, and this time it had nothing to do with the Knicks-Sixers matchup.

The legendary Hot 97 DJ found himself in a physical altercation with another man inside the packed Manhattan arena, with video capturing the confrontation as it spiraled into a full-blown scene. Flex posted the footage to Instagram early Wednesday, giving the internet a front-row seat to the chaos.

Dressed head to toe in black, Flex can be seen charging across a crowded room toward the man before the two get physical. The commotion quickly draws attention, with people scrambling away as the confrontation unfolds. Security personnel and an NYPD officer eventually get between the men, hustling Flex out of the room and into a hallway as they attempt to bring the temperature down.

But Flex wasn’t about to let the footage do all the talking.

In the caption accompanying his Instagram post, the veteran DJ addressed speculation that he had been punched during the incident. Writing in all caps, Flex insisted that the video missed the moment he was allegedly struck in the face.

He also offered his version of what sparked the confrontation, accusing the other man, whom he described as an employee of a record company, of trying to set him up. According to Flex, the man wanted Flex to throw the first punch so he could potentially sue him. Flex further alleged that the man called him a “A BROKE NI**A” before throwing a drink on him.

The DJ did not identify the man in his post, and the allegations have not been independently confirmed.

The incident adds an unexpected sideshow to a night that was supposed to be about basketball at one of New York City’s most recognizable sporting venues. Madison Square Garden, home of the Knicks and a longtime hub for hip-hop’s biggest names, became the backdrop for a confrontation that quickly made its way onto social media.

Representatives for the New York Police Department told outlets they had no information about the incident. Madison Square Garden had not responded to requests for comment as of publication.

For now, Flex has put his account of the dust-up out there, while questions remain about what happened before the cameras started rolling and whether the confrontation will lead to any further action.

item.title: You Might Have To Sell Some Organs To Get Sony & XBOX’s Next Consoles
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: Gaming is already an expensive hobby, and a new report from Fortune says it won't get any cheaper.
item.content:encoded:
According to reports, both Sony and XBOX will be asking for a lot of your hard-earned coins.

Gaming is already an expensive hobby, and a new report from Fortune says it won’t get any cheaper.

While we still have no definitive idea what exactly XBOX’s Project Helix is, despite rumors of it being a family of consoles, a new report from Fortune claims gamers could expect to dish out up to $1,800 if the company decides not to subsidize its next-gen console, which is due out by the holiday season in 2028.

The report also claims Microsoft is working on a new handheld that is due out in 2027.

“As it stands, the price of the Helix console has internally been projected to cost consumers between $1,200 and $1,800, unless Microsoft decides to subsidize the cost,” the report claims.

Microsoft historically has subsidized its consoles, unlike Sony and Nintendo, but we are in truly uncharted waters now that living room console prices have ballooned.

Project Helix won’t be alone, with Sony’s PS6 also reportedly costing over $1,000 because its memory components cost more than $700.

XBOX’s current CEO, Asha Sharma, is well aware of the challenge of keeping her company’s next console affordable, but that will be continue to be difficult due to the AI push gobbling up all of the resources like memory and storage for data centers.

Oh, and we can’t forget Trump and his abuse of tariffs, also making our lives a living hell on the gaming and tech front.

As expected, these prices have gamers panicking and wondering how in the hell they will continue to enjoy their favorite hobby, while also painting a grim outlook for Project Helix and PS6.

“So Project Helix is rumored to cost between $1200-$1800USD This thing is DOA, only super hardcore gamers would buy the thing, at this point you might as well delay it until this component crisis is over,” Reece Reilly wrote on X (formerly Twitter).

It’s a painful time to be a gamer. You can see more reactions to the possibly astronomical prices for Project Helix and the PS6 below.

item.dc:creator: Weso
item.description: PlaqueBoyMax isn’t going for the foolery. The streamer and producer recently caught wind of someone using his song on TikTok, and he was far from happy about it. item.content:encoded:
PlaqueBoyMax isn’t going for the foolery.

The streamer and producer recently caught wind of someone using his song on TikTok, and he was far from happy about it. The White House posted a video on TikTok featuring Donald Trump attempting to look cool.

At one point the video uses PlaqueBoyMax’s “Man Of The Year” record, seemingly hoping to add some aura to the clip. PBM was not feeling that whatsoever, respond to the post with the quickness:

“F*ck you n*gga.”

Following that, he hopped on stream and reached to the TikTok video, doubling down on his stance and even claiming he wants to take Trump’s spot as president.

“We run the country now, I told y’all we was gonna be president. Trump I want that spot you don’t deserve that sh*t…your’e a bad guy.”

PlaqueBoyMax made it clear that he wasn’t rocking with the White House using his music. His reaction also turned the situation into a larger conversation about artists and how their music gets used by political figures and government accounts.

Standing on business, PBM isn’t letting the moment slide without making his feelings known. Check out PlaqueBoyMax’s full reaction to the White House’s Donald Trump TikTok video below.

item.title: 10 Things To Know About A Superficial Blood Clot Diagnosis
item.dc:creator: Keenan Higgins
item.description: With shocking news of Eagles QB Jalen Hurts' recent blood clot diagnosis, we put together helpful tips to know about the sidelining ailment.
item.content:encoded:
Health scares can arrive at any time, and most importantly at anyone’s doorstep. We learned that recently with the shocking news of Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts’ blood clot diagnosis, which has forced him to sit out the remainder of the current NFL season.

His health status was shared with fans on Monday (October 19) in a joint statement from the Eagles and his agent, Nicole Lynn. Based on the statement (seen below), it’s understood that Hurts is currently on blood thinners to combat a diagnosis of deep vein thrombosis and bilateral pulmonary emboli, originally thought to be a superficial vein thrombosis in the left calf.

RELATED: Jalen Hurts Out For Season With Multiple Blood Clots

“The risk of superficial blood clot progressing to a deep vein thrombosis and/or a pulmonary embolism can vary depending on the risk factors of the individual, and especially the risk factors of the clot,” said Dr. Jordan K. Schaefer in a report by ESPN, relegating it to factors like length of the clot, where it is anatomically and ultimately how close it is to the deep vein system. She also stated, “All of these superficial blood clots have some degree of risk of progressing to a deep vein thrombosis or pulmonary embolism, and that’s why the follow-up is so important to monitor people over time and assess for clots that start as superficial vein thrombosis and turn into a deep vein thrombosis and/or pulmonary embolism.”

While the term “superficial” can make it seem less important in comparison to a DVT, in reality it should be treated more like an early warning sign towards a far more severe diagnosis. It’s believed that 10% of patients diagnosed with superficial clots will experience the clot moving to the deep-vein system, so quick detection can be the key factor that saves a life. Whether you’re a Super Bowl Champion QB or a regular 9-to-5 civilian, it’s worth knowing the essentials to getting ahead of a health issue that clearly doesn’t discriminate in its path.

Take a look below to get familiar on 10 important things to know when it comes to understanding a superficial blood clot diagnosis:

Know The Terms

A superficial venous thrombosis, also abbreviated as SVT, is a clot that develops in a vein closer to the skin’s surface. If untreated, it is often seen as the first stage towards deep vein thrombosis, or DVT, which forms in larger veins farther below the surface and can also trigger a pulmonary embolism to the lungs with fatal results.

item.title: NFL Will Not Punish Eagles in Jalen Hurts’ Blood Clot Situation
item.dc:creator: Deion Allen
item.description: NFL Will Not Punish Eagles in Jalen Hurts’ Blood Clot Situation The NFL will reportedly not discipline the Philadelphia Eagles following questions surrounding the team’s handling of quarterback Jalen Hurts’ medical condition. According to The Athletic, the league determined that the process used to clear Hurts to play against the Jacksonville Jaguars in London on […]
item.content:encoded:
NFL Will Not Punish Eagles in Jalen Hurts’ Blood Clot Situation

The NFL will reportedly not discipline the Philadelphia Eagles following questions surrounding the team’s handling of quarterback Jalen Hurts’ medical condition.

According to The Athletic, the league determined that the process used to clear Hurts to play against the Jacksonville Jaguars in London on October 11 was “handled appropriately.” The NFL will not issue punishment over the medical clearance process or the team’s failure to list Hurts on the injury report for that game.

The decision comes after Hurts was diagnosed with a superficial blood clot in his left calf before the matchup. Further testing later revealed deep vein thrombosis and blood clots in both lungs, leaving the Eagles quarterback expected to miss the remainder of the 2026 season.

RELATED: Eagles Entire RB Room is Injured as Will Shipley Suffers Foot Injury

Eagles head coach Nick Sirianni defended the organization’s medical staff amid growing scrutiny, stating, “I fully trust the people that are involved in helping us all make these decisions.” While the NFL’s review clears the Eagles of punishment, questions remain among fans and sports commentators about the circumstances surrounding Hurts’ initial diagnosis and clearance to play.

Hurts is reportedly stable and expected to make a full recovery. His absence, however, presents a major challenge for Philadelphia as the team looks to regain its footing during the 2026 season.

item.content:encoded:
New details surrounding Bloodhound Q50’s death have emerged following the release of his autopsy report.

According to reports, investigators recovered approximately 50 bullet casings at the crime scene. Q50 was struck by five bullets, sustaining gunshot wounds to his head, left shoulder, neck, and back.

The rapper was ambushed at a gas station in September, with surveillance footage reportedly capturing the deadly encounter. The footage showed Q50 entering the gas station, followed by one of the masked suspects. Moments later, after returning to his Tesla, he was attacked by the shooters.

The autopsy report also reportedly revealed that cannabis, benzodiazepines, and opioids were present in Q50’s system at the time of his death. Investigators reportedly recovered casings linked to both a rifle and a 9mm handgun at the scene.

Tragically, the violence didn’t end with Q50’s murder. His close friend Poohman was killed shortly after attending Q50’s funeral In a similar incident, Poohman was reportedly shot at a gas station near 76th Street and Cottage Grove Avenue in Chicago. He attempted to flee but crashed his vehicle shortly afterward and died from gunshot injuries. 

Bloodhound Q50 was laid to rest on Friday, September 25, in Merrillville, Indiana. Authorities reportedly on-site in large numbers to keep the service peaceful, with law enforcement from across Northwest Indiana helping provide security as family and friend gathered to pay their final respects.

item.title: Yung Miami: “I Remember Everybody That Had Something to Say”
item.dc:creator: Nia Noelle
item.description: Yung Miami drops her debut solo album Watch This, celebrating her journey from doubters to No. 1 hits while staying authentic and protecting her peace.
item.content:encoded:
Yung Miami walked into Posted On The Corner looking like money and radiating nothing but good energy. Just days before dropping her debut solo album Watch This on Oct. 23, Caresha linked up with hosts DJ Misses and Incognito for a real one: part vibe session, part victory lap, all facts.

“Is it Friday yet?” she laughed. “I feel really good about my music.”

And honestly? The culture feels it too.

“Spend It” Ran the Summer and Then Hit No. 1

When Caresha last pulled up to the corner, “Spend It” had just dropped. By the time summer was over, that record had taken over everything: cookouts, reels, playlists, even somebody’s church collection. It went straight to No. 1, and Caresha got emotional when the call came in.

“Imagine people telling you no,” she said. “And God say, yeah.”

Say less. That’s the energy.

The Album Is Her Therapy and She Is Not Holding Back

DJ Misses told her listening to “FU” felt like reading her diary. Caresha didn’t even flinch. “I don’t be lying in my raps,” she said, and that’s exactly what makes Watch This hit different.

She warned fans straight up: “You might cry.” Because this project goes there. It’s real, it’s raw, and it’s hers.

The whole album rocks a Miami Vice aesthetic: vibrant colors, big hair, ’80s glam with a Miami twist. The standout track “2008” mixes that Atlanta grit with Miami soul. Producer J White built the beat, but Caresha knew it needed one finishing touch: DJ Drama. Watching him flip the switch from regular conversation to that legendary hype voice in the studio? She was shook. “How the [heck] you do that?” she said. But the moment he did it, she knew that was the missing piece.

She Remembers Every Hater. Every Single One

For years, people came for her pen, her voice, her spot in hip hop. They slept. Caresha didn’t forget. “I remember everybody that had something to say about me,” she said with that smile that says more than words ever could.

She wasn’t asking for people to stop having opinions, just to keep it respectful. “You could say you don’t like something, but why you got to be disrespectful with it?” Real talk.

As for protecting her peace through all the noise? “My peace is going to sleep.” Because rest is resistance, sis.

This is the part every young creative needs to hear. Muni built her come-up through her own label, Supergiant Records, before linking with Def Jam. She was not waiting for the industry to hand her anything. In the conversation, she broke down why ownership is everything. Not just for the bag, but for your peace and your power. For a generation of Black artists done with giving their work away, Muni’s approach is the move.

TRENDING STORY: News Flash: Yung Miami Says Her Next Man Has To Be “God Fearing” With A $100 Million

TRENDING STORY: New Music Mondays: Victoria Monét, Drake, Yung Miami & More

Mama Mode, HBCU Love, and the Road Ahead

Caresha’s whole face lit up talking about her kids. Her daughter Summer’s birthday? Same day the album drops. That’s a sign. When asked about a superpower she discovered on this journey, she kept it grounded: “I got a good heart.”

The solo tour is loading, and she’s especially hyped about hitting Clark Atlanta University. HBCU crowds go crazy, and she’s here for every second of it. “They be lit,” she said. She also kept it real with the young ones: stay in school, get the experience if you can, but college isn’t the only path to success. Her whole life is proof of that.

Before she bounced, Caresha left the people with something to hold onto: “Stay true to yourself. Whatever it is, go after it. The most important thing is to be happy.”

item.title: Blueface Arrested In Santa Clarita For Allegedly Delaying Police Investigation
item.dc:creator: Stephen A. Crockett Jr.
item.description: Blueface has found himself on the wrong side of the law again, this time after allegedly interfering with a police investigation in Los Angeles County. The rapper was arrested Monday night in Santa Clarita on suspicion of delaying a law enforcement investigation, a representative for the Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Office told TMZ. According to […]
item.content:encoded:
Blueface has found himself on the wrong side of the law again, this time after allegedly interfering with a police investigation in Los Angeles County.

The rapper was arrested Monday night in Santa Clarita on suspicion of delaying a law enforcement investigation, a representative for the Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Office told TMZ.

According to the sheriff’s office, deputies responding to a call detained several people at the scene, including Blueface. The rapper allegedly refused to follow their commands, leading to his arrest.

Authorities ultimately determined that the incident stemmed from a bogus swatting call. Swatting involves making a false emergency report to dispatch police or other emergency responders to a specific location, potentially putting innocent people at risk.

Video of the encounter shows Blueface and several of his friends dressed in Halloween costumes resembling superheroes. The group reportedly told deputies from the outset that they were not carrying weapons.

Monday’s arrest marks the latest in a string of legal troubles for the rapper, whose real name is Johnathan Porter. In August, he was detained by police during a livestream, just months after his November 2025 release from prison.

Blueface previously served time in connection with a 2022 shooting outside a Las Vegas strip club. He was sentenced in that case and remains on probation, according to previous reports.

Despite his latest run-in with law enforcement, the rapper has also had some personal news worth celebrating. Earlier this month, Blueface proposed to his longtime on-and-off girlfriend, Chrisean Rock, marking another chapter in the couple’s turbulent relationship.

For now, though, Blueface has another legal headache to deal with as he navigates life outside prison. Whether Monday’s arrest leads to additional consequences remains to be seen.

item.title: Drake Denies Stealing “Janice STFU” Hook After Alleged Reference Track Surfaces
item.dc:creator: Weso
item.description: Drake is no stranger to reference tracks, and now another one has surface amid a legal back-and-forth over his music. The OVO rapper released his long-awaited album, ICEMAN, this year, delivering records like “Shabang,” “Ran To Atlanta,” and “Whisper My Name.” Each track has made noise for different reasons. “Shabang” became the official opening theme […]
item.content:encoded:
Drake is no stranger to reference tracks, and now another one has surface amid a legal back-and-forth over his music.

The OVO rapper released his long-awaited album, ICEMAN, this year, delivering records like “Shabang,” “Ran To Atlanta,” and “Whisper My Name.”

Each track has made noise for different reasons. “Shabang” became the official opening theme for WWE NXT, while “Ran To Atlanta” marked the first time Drake and Future had released music together in years. The record also sparked conversation over its alleged response to Kendrick Lamar, but that’s a story for another day.

Then there’s “Whisper My Name,” where Drizzy addresses multiple people, including allegedly taking shots at JAŸ-Z.

However, one record on ICEMAN that continues to make headlines is “Janice STFU.” After Drake jokingly threw an apology party for women name Janice, courtesy of The Boy, the track is not the center of a legal dispute.

Songwriter Avi Hirschfield claims he wrote the song’s hook and that Drake used it without permission. Hirschfield reportedly uploaded an early demo of his version in January 2026 after discovering the beat online, which he says was produced by FNZ.

FNZ is also credited as one of the producers on Drake’s “Janice STFU.” According to Hirschfield’s allegations, the producer sent his version of the song to Drake, setting the stage for what would eventually become the ICEMAN rappers track.

In his lawsuit, Avi argues that he deserves a share of the song’s earnings, pointing to its commercial success and claiming that the hook he wrote is the key element that caught listener’s attention. He also alleges that Drake’s version uses his hook word for word.

“The immense success of Janice STFU is due principally to the song’s chorus, which is a literal, word-for-word, note-for-note taking.”

Drake’s representative. however, has firmly denied the allegations, dismissing claims that the rapper obtained the song’s lyrics from someone else.

“Drake wrote this song and has no connection or knowledge of this person, full stop.”

item.title: ‘Power’ Creator Courtney Kemp Tells 50 Cent To “Move On” After He Takes Shots At Her
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: 50 Cent publicly criticized Power creator Courtney Kemp over budget issues and her role, then attacked her character when she clapped back, sparking social media debate.
item.content:encoded:
50 Cent continues to prove he will turn on you on a dime if you do or say something he doesn’t like.

In a new interview with Variety, the Street Fighter star took off his boxing gloves and said nothing nice about Courtney Kemp, creator of the Starz hit drama Power, blaming her for budget issues, downplaying his role in the rise of the Power Universe, and claiming she slept with cast and crew members.

If you ask social media, Power is basically the brainchild of the Queen’s hip-hop star, but that is far from the truth: Kemp wrote and developed the concept as the showrunner. At the same time, 50 Cent served as an executive producer and eventually joined the cast.

Regardless, 50 Cent told Variety that Kemp downplayed his contributions to the series. When asked if there was someone he never wanted to collaborate with ever again, he immediately mentioned Kemp.

“I don’t think that she’s wholeheartedly a bad person, I just think that it got out of control for her,” 50 Cent said. “After the success of Power, she would go, ‘I wrote it.’ Well, you did write it, but I uploaded everything that you wrote, and we got a ‘no’ from everybody before we got a ‘yes,’ and I wrote songs that captured, at its nucleus, each one of the leads that we had and that emotionally captured energy for scenes.”

He went on to claim his songs were instrumental in pitching to Starz’s then-CEO Chris Albrecht, saying Kemp “forgot” about his contributions.

50 Cent Believes He Was Instrumental In Pushing The Show & Its Success

The G-Unit general said he had a lot of power pushing the show, leading to the cable network keeping the show, drawing eyes on the show, and making it the powerhouse it has become, going on to spawn several spinoff series, one of them being Raising Kanan, which 50 Cent claimed Kemp didn’t want to happen.

“Half the s**t she was saying just didn’t make sense,” he added.

Well, Kemp had time for Curtis Jackson and, in a statement to Variety, said he was rarely at budget meetings but wished him well, gave him credit for helping make the show be a success, and basically wants him to keep her name out of his mouth.

“While 50’s recollection of budgets and production requirements is uninformed, as he was rarely in a budget meeting, I have never once understated his importance in the genesis of Power. While he did not write nor create the series, he was a large part of its birth. That said, I am completely bewildered by his need to mention me in interviews or podcasts. I have completely moved on in my career, and I hope that the imminent success of Street Fighter allows him to do the same.”

Well damn.

In response to Kemp’s statement, 50 Cent hopped on social media and basically slut shaming her, accusing her of sleeping with cast and crew members in a post that has since been deleted.

This isn’t the first time 50 Cent has taken a swipe at Kemp, but she usually dismisses it as playful banter; this is the first time she’s clapped back at the rapper/mogul.

Cardi B did her big one stepping into the Tiny Desk office and putting on a show.

Taking her talents to Washington, D.C., Bardi did NOT come to play. The Bronx MC performed some of her biggest hits, including “ErrTime,” “Up,” and her classic breakout record, “Bodak Yellow.”

The New York MC has been on a generational run and shows no signs of slowing down. After ending her seven-year album drought, Cardi released her sophmore album, AM I THE DRAMA?, last year.

The project marked her first full-length album since her Grammy-winning debut, Invasion of Privacy, dropped in 2018. Since then, Cardi has continued to make major moves, keeping her name in the conversation while delivering the energy fans have come to expect.

Following the album’s release in September, she also joined Bad Bunny during his Super Bowl halftime show, adding another major moment to her growing list of career highlights. Now, she’s bringing the same star power to NPR’s Tiny Desk series, giving fans a chance to hear some of her biggest records in a different setting.

item.title: Cardi B Took Over Tiny Desk, And The Internet Is Here For It
item.dc:creator: Stephen A. Crockett Jr.
item.description: There are only a few times where it seems like the world still loves all of us. Like when there is that one time around the end of October when the NFL, NBA, college basketball, and the MLB playoffs are all on television at the same time. Or when Drake saved Top Boy to give […]
item.content:encoded:
There are only a few times where it seems like the world still loves all of us. Like when there is that one time around the end of October when the NFL, NBA, college basketball, and the MLB playoffs are all on television at the same time. Or when Drake saved Top Boy to give the show the proper ending it deserved. And you learn on a random Monday that Tiny Desk is Bardigang and got Belcalis Marlenis Almánzar to grace the office and set the desk ablaze.

Cardi B’s performance dropped and the internet clocked in like it was a Bronx block party. And for those that think Cardi’s performances are all flash and fancy outfits will be shocked to see the stripped down live performance and her larger-than-life personality into a space where there are no arena-sized screens, pyrotechnics or elaborate stage productions to hide behind. Just Cardi, a live band, a whole lot of hits and that unmistakable Cardi B energy.

The performance, which included “Hello,” “ErrTime,” “Man of Your Word,” “Be Careful,” “Up,” “AH HA,” “Bodak Yellow” and “I Like It,” gave fans a little bit of everything: the brash confidence, the vulnerability, the jokes and the party-starting records that helped make her a superstar. NPR even reported that the crowd was so large that some people had to be turned away. Being that NPR is in Washington, D.C., Cardi even dropped a small shout out to UCB’s “Sexy Lady” at the end of her set. 

Tiny Desk has become one of those rare corners of the internet where artists can remind people why they fell in love with them in the first place. Here is a look at the party thrown on X in honor of Cardi B’s performance.

Jam made headlines after serving as a key witness in Durk’s federal murder-for-hire case. He famously became the first OTF member to take the stand against Durk, accusing the rapper of allegedly orchestrated crimes. One of […]
item.content:encoded:
With both OTF Jam and Lil Durk remain behind bars, Jam appears to be sneak dissing the Chicago rapper.

Jam made headlines after serving as a key witness in Durk’s federal murder-for-hire case. He famously became the first OTF member to take the stand against Durk, accusing the rapper of allegedly orchestrated crimes.

One of the cases centered on the 2022 killing of Quando Rondo’s cousin, Lul Pab, in Los Angeles. However, Durk was acquitted of the charges in that case after the court found the prosecution has not met its burden of proof.

While awaiting further sentencing related to his own involvement in the case, Jam remains behind bars. Despite his incarceration, the former OTF member appears to still have access to his Instagram account, where a new post sparked more conversation about his ongoing tension with Durk.

The post featured a clip from the classic movie Don’t Be a Menace to South Central While Drinking Your Juice in the Hood. Jam captioned the clip, “The Nation of Lil Durk’s,” seemingly taking another jab at the rapper.

Meanwhile, Durk has yet to respond to Jam’s latest apparent shots as he awaits his next court proceedings. His separate VICAR case, which was originally scheduled to begin in October, has been pushed back to August 2027.
